verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API platform (cards, payments, transactions, expense data) and an MCP server covering card management, reimbursements, vendor/bill pay, and transaction queries, giving AI-native users meaningful API-level access to core functions. However, there's no explicit claim of full UI/API parity, several UI features (team invites/permissions, invoice approval workflows, cash yield/FX conversion between currencies) aren't clearly exposed via API/MCP, and probes show the OpenAPI spec/llms.txt are unreachable at the redocly host, undermining discoverability of full API surface. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, complete endpoint coverage matching every UI feature, working public API spec discovery.
